name: duopore-public-exam-practice-routine
description: Build an exam practice plan that leaves time to check your answers.

interface.longDescription: Build an exam practice plan that leaves time to check your answers. Enter study dates, available minutes, task priorities and how many practice-and-review rounds you want. See whole rounds that fit and those still unplanned. For adults planning their own study. The app keeps answer review time separate and does not predict grades or mastery.
defaultPrompt: Fit these practice questions and review rounds into my study dates.
How many complete practice-and-review blocks fit before my exam?
